headline: Feature the Marino, Verges, Lukenbill combo
evidence: Marino, Verges, Lukenbill: +9.8 per 40 after shrinkage (+19.2 raw) · on/off +2.1 · 42 competitive min in 3 games
reasoning: How this combo was chosen: every 3-player group from our lineup stints, using COMPETITIVE minutes only -- a stint that starts in the 2nd half or OT with the margin at 15+ is garbage time and set aside. A trio needs 40+ competitive minutes across 3+ games. It is ranked by scoring margin per 40 minutes, shrunk toward zero as if 40 more minutes of an even game were added (so a short hot streak can't top the list), and it must also be ON/OFF positive -- we do better with these three on the floor than without them, which is what separates the trio from whoever else was out there with them. Season-wide, not specific to this opponent.
